using JSON
using Glob

const METRICS = ["lddt", "bb_lddt", "tm_score", "rmsd"]

function compute_af3_metrics(preds::String, evals::String, name::String)
    metrics = Dict{String, Vector{Float64}}()
    top_model = nothing
    top_confidence = -1e6
    for model_id in 0:4
        confidence_file = joinpath(preds, @sprintf("seed-1_sample-%d", model_id), "summary_confidences.json")
        confidence_data = JSON.parsefile(confidence_file)
        confidence = confidence_data["ranking_score"]
        if confidence > top_confidence
            top_model = model_id
            top_confidence = confidence
        end
        eval_file = joinpath(evals, @sprintf("%s_model_%d.json", name, model_id))
        eval_data = JSON.parsefile(eval_file)
        for metric_name in METRICS
            if haskey(eval_data, metric_name)
                get!(metrics, metric_name, Float64[]) |> push!(eval_data[metric_name])
            end
        end
        if haskey(eval_data, "dockq") && !isnothing(eval_data["dockq"])
            valid_dockq = filter(!isnothing, eval_data["dockq"])
            get!(metrics, "dockq_>0.23", Float64[]) |> push!(mean(Float64.(v > 0.23 for v in valid_dockq)))
            get!(metrics, "dockq_>0.49", Float64[]) |> push!(mean(Float64.(v > 0.49 for v in valid_dockq)))
            get!(metrics, "len_dockq_", Int[]) |> push!(length(valid_dockq))
        end
        eval_file = joinpath(evals, @sprintf("%s_model_%d_ligand.json", name, model_id))
        if isfile(eval_file)
            eval_data = JSON.parsefile(eval_file)
            if haskey(eval_data, "lddt_pli")
                lddt_plis = Float64[]
                for x in eval_data["lddt_pli"]["assigned_scores"]
                    push!(lddt_plis, x["score"])
                end
                for _ in eval_data["lddt_pli"]["model_ligand_unassigned_reason"]
                    push!(lddt_plis, 0.0)
                end
                if !isempty(lddt_plis)
                    lddt_pli = mean(lddt_plis)
                    get!(metrics, "lddt_pli", Float64[]) |> push!(lddt_pli)
                    get!(metrics, "len_lddt_pli", Int[]) |> push!(length(lddt_plis))
                end
            end
            if haskey(eval_data, "rmsd")
                rmsds = Float64[]
                for x in eval_data["rmsd"]["assigned_scores"]
                    push!(rmsds, x["score"])
                end
                for _ in eval_data["rmsd"]["model_ligand_unassigned_reason"]
                    push!(rmsds, 100.0)
                end
                if !isempty(rmsds)
                    rmsd2 = mean(Float64.(v < 2.0 for v in rmsds))
                    rmsd5 = mean(Float64.(v < 5.0 for v in rmsds))
                    get!(metrics, "rmsd<2", Float64[]) |> push!(rmsd2)
                    get!(metrics, "rmsd<5", Float64[]) |> push!(rmsd5)
                    get!(metrics, "len_rmsd", Int[]) |> push!(length(rmsds))
                end
            end
        end
    end
    oracle = Dict{String, Any}()
    avg = Dict{String, Any}()
    top1 = Dict{String, Any}()
    for (k,v) in metrics
        if k == "rmsd"
            oracle[k] = minimum(v)
        else
            oracle[k] = maximum(v)
        end
        avg[k] = mean(v)
        top1[k] = v[top_model + 1]
    end
    results = Dict{String, Any}()
    for metric_name in keys(metrics)
        if startswith(metric_name, "len_")
            continue
        end
        if metric_name == "lddt_pli"
            l = metrics["len_lddt_pli"][1]
        elseif metric_name == "rmsd<2" || metric_name == "rmsd<5"
            l = metrics["len_rmsd"][1]
        elseif metric_name == "dockq_>0.23" || metric_name == "dockq_>0.49"
            l = metrics["len_dockq_"][1]
        else
            l = 1
        end
        results[metric_name] = Dict(
            "oracle" => oracle[metric_name],
            "average" => avg[metric_name],
            "top1" => top1[metric_name],
            "len" => l,
        )
    end
    return results
end

function eval_models(
    chai_preds::String,
    chai_evals::String,
    af3_preds::String,
    af3_evals::String,
    boltz_preds::String,
    boltz_evals::String,
    boltz_preds_x::String,
    boltz_evals_x::String,
)
    chai_preds_names = Dict{String,String}()
    af3_preds_names = Dict{String,String}()
    boltz_preds_names = Dict{String,String}()
    boltz_preds_names_x = Dict{String,String}()

    for x in filter(x->!startswith(basename(x), "."), Glob.glob(joinpath(chai_preds,"*")))
        chai_preds_names[lowercase(basename(x))] = x
    end
    for x in filter(x->!startswith(basename(x), "."), Glob.glob(joinpath(af3_preds,"*")))
        af3_preds_names[lowercase(basename(x))] = x
    end
    for x in filter(x->!startswith(basename(x), "."), Glob.glob(joinpath(boltz_preds,"*")))
        boltz_preds_names[lowercase(basename(x))] = x
    end
    for x in filter(x->!startswith(basename(x), "."), Glob.glob(joinpath(boltz_preds_x,"*")))
        boltz_preds_names_x[lowercase(basename(x))] = x
    end

    println("Chai preds ", length(chai_preds_names))
    println("Af3 preds ", length(af3_preds_names))
    println("Boltz preds ", length(boltz_preds_names))
    println("Boltzx preds ", length(boltz_preds_names_x))

    common = intersect(intersect(intersect(collect(keys(chai_preds_names)), collect(keys(af3_preds_names))), collect(keys(boltz_preds_names))), collect(keys(boltz_preds_names_x)))
    keys_to_remove = ["t1133", "h1134", "r1134s1", "t1134s2", "t1121", "t1123", "t1159"]
    for key in keys_to_remove
        if key in common
            deleteat!(common, findfirst(isequal(key), common))
        end
    end
    println("Common ", length(common))

    results = DataFrame(tool=String[], target=String[], metric=String[], value=Float64[])

    pb = Progress(length(common))
    for name in common
        af3_results = try
            compute_af3_metrics(af3_preds_names[name], af3_evals, name)
        catch e
            @warn "Error evaluating AF3 $name: $e"
            continue
        end
        chai_results = try
            compute_chai_metrics(chai_preds_names[name], chai_evals, name)
        catch e
            @warn "Error evaluating Chai $name: $e"
            continue
        end
        boltz_results = try
            compute_boltz_metrics(boltz_preds_names[name], boltz_evals, name)
        catch e
            @warn "Error evaluating Boltz $name: $e"
            continue
        end
        boltz_results_x = try
            compute_boltz_metrics(boltz_preds_names_x[name], boltz_evals_x, name)
        catch e
            @warn "Error evaluating Boltzx $name: $e"
            continue
        end
        for metric_name in keys(af3_results)
            if haskey(chai_results, metric_name) && haskey(boltz_results, metric_name) && haskey(boltz_results_x, metric_name)
                len_vals = (af3_results[metric_name]["len"], chai_results[metric_name]["len"], boltz_results[metric_name]["len"], boltz_results_x[metric_name]["len"])
                if all(x->x==len_vals[1], len_vals)
                    push!(results, ( "AF3 oracle", name, metric_name, af3_results[metric_name]["oracle"] ))
                    push!(results, ( "AF3 top-1", name, metric_name, af3_results[metric_name]["top1"] ))
                    push!(results, ( "Chai-1 oracle", name, metric_name, chai_results[metric_name]["oracle"] ))
                    push!(results, ( "Chai-1 top-1", name, metric_name, chai_results[metric_name]["top1"] ))
                    push!(results, ( "Boltz-1 oracle", name, metric_name, boltz_results[metric_name]["oracle"] ))
                    push!(results, ( "Boltz-1 top-1", name, metric_name, boltz_results[metric_name]["top1"] ))
                    push!(results, ( "Boltz-1x oracle", name, metric_name, boltz_results_x[metric_name]["oracle"] ))
                    push!(results, ( "Boltz-1x top-1", name, metric_name, boltz_results_x[metric_name]["top1"] ))
                else
                    @warn "Different lengths $name $metric_name " * string(len_vals)
                end
            else
                @warn "Missing metric $name $metric_name $(haskey(chai_results, metric_name)) $(haskey(boltz_results, metric_name)) $(haskey(boltz_results_x, metric_name))"
            end
        end
        next!(pb)
    end
    return results
end
